name: kyrgyz-gec-benchmark
description: A Kyrgyz grammatical error correction benchmark designed to evaluate models' ability to detect and correct grammatical errors in Kyrgyz text. It measures models' editing/correction capability on a low-resource language, useful for evaluating seq2seq and edit-based correction systems. Targets research on multilingual and low-resource GEC.
reputation: A niche, low-resource-language benchmark with limited adoption so far but valuable for Kyrgyz NLP and multilingual GEC research.
